headline: DeepSeek documents public Search and Fetch APIs with per-request billing and account rate limits
summary: DeepSeek’s Oct 17 documentation describes raw JSON Search and Fetch APIs for live web content, using the regular API bearer authentication. Search returns structured results from DeepSeek’s in-house engine; Fetch returns one page as Markdown. The guide lists $0.75 per 1,000 successful requests for each API, with 5 requests per second per account for both. It says server-side calls made through Codex, Claude Code or DeepSeek Harness are currently free, with per-request billing scheduled to start Nov 1, 2026, Beijing time. No API call or retrieval-quality evaluation was performed in this review.
